integrity: All reduced support/mean-position cases through seven atoms and the eight-atom witness are certified by exact rational arithmetic. Displayed decimal approximations are explanatory only and are not proof inputs.
scientific_limitations: Finite-support result with integer mean; no claim is made for larger supports or noninteger means.
The published half-space extreme-point theorem for discrete log-concave laws is used as a premise rather than reproved.
The result does not classify all eight-point counterexamples or determine the optimal lower-tail constant for each support size.
Literature search cannot establish absolute absence of an unlocated equivalent result.
title: Eight atoms are minimal for a discrete log-concave half-mass failure at an integer mean
